about: Every paid picture job. run one with: python3 tools/runway.py run <name>. files lists local inputs sent inline. Prompts follow the four-part form: summary, timeline in whole seconds, consistency, and only two negatives.

whale_t1.what: whale shot, draft, text only: look, 24 fps, can the child be generated and speak

body.promptText:
Summary: At blue hour on a lived-in rooftop garden, a nine-year-old girl in an adult's navy work jacket holds a glowing tube of cyan light up to a sperm whale gliding through a sky that is the underside of an ocean, in an ultramarine fisheye style with hard on-camera flash on the foreground, then spins and pushes the tube into the lens.

0-1s: Whip tilt up from her raised fist, holding the glowing cyan tube, into deep blue.
1-7s: 8mm fisheye, 25 cm above the edge of a planter. Foreground: white daisies and long grass, hit by hard on-camera flash. Middle: the girl, small in frame, back to camera, a striped top and jeans under the navy jacket with rolled sleeves, holding the tube above her head like a lantern, standing well inside the roof's parapet. Around her: a washing line with one navy jacket, a tripod carrying a hydrophone, a cable running to a laptop on a milk crate. Glass towers bend in at the frame edges. Above them the sky is a rippling water surface seen from below, slow caustic light moving over the towers. A sperm whale glides through that water from left to right. Each time the tube blinks, a ring spreads across the surface overhead. The camera rises very slightly.
7-9s: 100mm macro. One eye of the same girl fills the frame, lit blue, one white point of light in it. The whale's shape crosses the reflection from left to right. She breathes in, and the breath becomes a laugh.
9-12s: 8mm fisheye, 30 cm from her. The same gap-toothed girl in the navy jacket spins toward the camera and pushes the tube straight at the lens with both hands, laughing. Dialogue (the girl): "Somebody starts it." Her fingers become huge and flash-lit, and the tube grows until it is one vertical band of cyan from the top of frame to the bottom, dead centre.

Consistency: ultramarine, navy and cyan carry every frame, with white only on the flowers. The same girl, jacket and tube throughout. No subtitles. No music. Sound: wind, the distant city, and slow clicks under water.

A plain light-grey plaster wall filling the whole frame, photographed straight on. Soft, even, cool light from above. Subtle trowel texture and two or three small scuffs. Nothing stands in front of it. An architectural texture photograph of an empty interior wall, completely unoccupied.

A navy blue cotton work jacket, a plain chore coat with three patch pockets and dark buttons, hanging on a single hook against a light-grey plaster wall, soft top light, straight-on product photograph. No logo, no label, no text, no people.

A vast dim industrial hall at night. At the far end a slow fan the size of a wall is backlit by cyan light through haze. Long workbenches in silhouette, thin smoke streamlines drifting toward the camera. Low, wide-angle, locked-off view. Ultramarine and navy tones with one cyan source. No people, no text, no signage.

A small lived-in kitchen at night, lit only by one warm desk lamp over a wooden table. On the table: an old open laptop seen from behind, a dismantled sewing machine on spread newspaper with unreadable print, a mug, a dusting of flour. Warm tungsten light, deep soft shadows, 40mm lens, eye level. No people, no readable text.

A lived-in rooftop garden at blue hour, ringed by glass towers. In the foreground a planter of white daisies and long grass lit by hard on-camera flash. Behind it a washing line with one navy jacket, a tripod carrying a small hydrophone, a cable running to a laptop on a milk crate. Deep ultramarine sky. 8mm fisheye lens, low viewpoint. No people, no text.

A 30 centimetre glass tube glowing solid cyan, a small light baton, lying on dark navy cloth, its glow spilling softly onto the fabric. Clean product photograph, dark background. No hands, no people, no text.

5-6s: Pip, a girl of nine, stands on the floor, so only the top of her hair enters the bottom of the frame.
6-7s: Rosa, a woman in her late sixties with grey hair pinned up and flour on her sleeve, head bowed.
7-9s: Mara, a woman in her mid-forties with dark hair tied back and a solder burn on her right knuckle, head bowed, then raises her eyes to the lens.

23-26s: Close-up of the same Mara. She smiles for the first time. Dialogue (Mara): @Audio6, "Yeah. It is."

Consistency: the same frame, wall, light and jacket in every shot. Cool, slightly desaturated high key, the navy rich. Each face stays the same every time that person returns. No subtitles. No music, room tone only.

body.promptText:
@Image1 is the wall and the framing of the portrait shots. @Image2 is the navy work jacket she wears. @Image3 is the hall. @Audio1 to @Audio5 are her finished voice lines and the only voice: generate no other voice.

Summary: One woman, Mara, in two places: first standing in a locked-off portrait frame against the light-grey plaster wall of @Image1, in a cool high-key portrait style with no camera movement, then in the long dark workshop hall of @Image3, at her workbench and walking into the wind of a wall-sized fan, in a navy-and-cyan backlit style with haze, crushed blacks and bloom.

Mara, in every shot: a lean South Asian woman in her mid-forties with black hair tied back in a low ponytail, loose strands at both temples, heavy dark eyebrows and no make-up, a small solder burn on her right knuckle, wearing the navy work jacket of @Image2 buttoned to the collar.

0-3s: The wall of @Image1. Locked camera at eye level, 65mm, waist-up, Mara dead centre, shoulders square, soft top light. Her head is bowed. Then she raises her head and her eyes come up to the lens.
3-6s: Same wall, close-up at 100mm. Mara's eyes on the lens. Dialogue (Mara): @Audio1, "Everybody's got a prediction."
6-8s: Same close-up. She does not blink. Dialogue (Mara): @Audio2, "Constantly."
8-11s: Same close-up. She smiles for the first time, slowly. Dialogue (Mara): @Audio3, "Yeah. It is."
11-15s: The hall of @Image3. 18mm lens resting on a scarred steel workbench. In the foreground a small relay on a breadboard and a coil of solder, grazed by hard cyan light. Mara plants both hands on the bench and leans down and in until her face fills the frame. Dialogue (Mara): @Audio4, "It finishes things." She holds the look. Hard cyan backlight flares over her left shoulder.
15-18s: Same bench, medium close-up. Mara pulls the cap off a red wax pencil with her teeth and spits the cap aside. Dialogue (Mara): @Audio5, "So we check."
18-22s: The hall, from the front, low, a wide lens tracking backward as Mara walks toward the camera into the wind of the fan, leaning into it, her hair and jacket whipping behind her. Long strips of blank white paper whip past both sides of the lens and past her.
22-26s: Close on Mara in the wind. A strip of blank paper plasters itself across her cheek. She peels it off and looks at it.
26-30s: She snorts, lets the wind take the strip, and keeps walking past the camera.

Consistency: the same woman in every shot: the same face, hair and jacket at the wall and in the hall. At the wall: cool, slightly desaturated high key, the navy rich, and nothing but her and the wall in the frame. In the hall: navy and cyan only, apart from the red pencil. The paper strips are blank, with no writing. No subtitles. No music. Sound at the wall: room tone only. Sound in the hall: wind, paper snapping, the hum of the fan.
